observations: Photos show a white/grey office photocopier with the brand text 'SHARP' visible.
Model marking 'AR-M207' is readable on photo 0 and photo 2.
Machine appears wrapped in plastic; control panel/outputs/toner area are not clearly shown.
No clear photo of serial number, screen, ports, paper trays details, or any running/print test.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only seller text.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: No functional/spec sheet or screen/menu photo shown to verify features.
Photos show 'SHARP AR-M207' on photo 0 and photo 2, not M307.

risks.risk: Wrong model claimed (seller says M307 but photos show AR-M207). This affects compatibility of parts, expected performance, and correct pricing.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the model nameplate/serial label (close-up) and the machine’s startup screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as not confidently identified and price at the low end of similar Sharp/entry B/W copiers.

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (wrapped in plastic; no print/copy test shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the machine powering on and producing a few test copies (including a page with text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs service until proven working.

risks.risk: Missing/unknown consumables and maintenance state (toner/drum/toner cartridge status not visible).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the toner/drum area (or toner level indicator) and a screenshot/photo of maintenance counters if available.

risks.risk: Potential paper-feed or scanning faults (not testable from current photos).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing paper feeding from the tray and scanning/copying multiple pages without jams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as prone to faults until a jam-free multi-page test is shown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (nameplate) showing the exact model and serial number.
Short video: power on + startup screen + copying/printing at least 3–5 pages (no jams).
Photo of toner/drum area or toner level indicator (and any maintenance/counter screen if accessible).
Photo of paper trays and output tray, plus a quick demonstration of paper feed.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Sharp AR-M207, but the seller text claims M307 and provides no working/print test. Without proof of the correct model and working condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
